Checklist

  • One idea: a closed ring. Nameable in under 5 seconds; the 48 px and 29 px silhouettes above are the whole icon.
  • Ring stroke 92 px on a 294 px radius (outer 680 px = 66 % of the canvas); 3.9 px at 48 px, 2.6 px at 29 px.
  • Sealed green #3ECF8E = the SEALED state of the in-app seal; filament #F0B35B = the accent; graphite #1B2129 to #0D1115, never pure black (§9.9).
  • Not a shield, not a lock, not a spark; no text; no baked corners or shadows (iOS, Play and the launchers apply their own masks).
  • Android foreground scaled to 79 % so the ring stays inside the 66 dp safe zone; monochrome layer is the ring alone.
